tests: R1: the selection is asked first, at weight report (retrieval R19): an unknown handle is refused before any citing object is looked up
R1, R9: an absent citing object and a project the viewer may not see answer the same NO_SUCH_PROJECT, membership's own answer (its R78) byte for byte; existence-only sight answers membership's C-70.1
R1: NOT_A_PROJECT for a citing object that is neither a project nor an inquiry, naming what it is; a legacy question spelling is the inquiry arm
R1: a project needs the actor joined (membership.projectAuthority): an administrator who sees it is refused, a joined owner is not; the question arm asks no position
R1, R11: BAD_NOTE (C-33.15) over 200 characters or with a quote, backslash or newline, carrying its row; a 200-character plain note passes
R1, R11: on an inquiry NO_ROLE (C-33.16) and BAD_ROLE (C-33.17) carry the role vocabulary; on a project ROLE_NOT_APPLICABLE (C-33.18)
R1: without inquiry's services the question arm is refused INQUIRY_UNAVAILABLE and writes nothing; the case arm is unaffected
R1: NOT_CITABLE (inquiry) and NOT_INFORMATION (project) name every member neither information nor an inquiry, sorted, with `citable`, and never narrow the call
R1, R5, R11: RETIRED_NOT_CITABLE (C-33.39) names every retired member, on both arms, and is asked of a retired bias set too
R1: an unreadable citing document is NO_BUNDLE_MD or UNPARSEABLE_FRONTMATTER
R1, R11: SEVERED_EDGE (C-33.19) for a member the citing object holds a severed edge to, naming only those, the whole call refused

R1, R11: the part — UNKNOWN_EXTENT_FIELD (C-45.7) listing the fields taken, EXTENT_NOT_APPLICABLE (C-45.8) on a project, EXTENT_ON_MANY (C-45.9) for more than one new member, BAD_EXTENT_VALUE (C-45.10)
R1: a part the leg grammar refuses (inquiry.checkLegExtentGrammar) is BASIS_REFUSED with each finding, before anything is written
R1: EMPTY_SELECTION when every member left the selection (purged), after the part is judged
R1: UNSPLICEABLE_REFERENCES when the references block cannot be extended in place, UNSPLICEABLE_BASIS for the basis block
R1: past 1 MiB, CITATION_TOO_LARGE with how many would fit, nothing written

R1: a refusal from the write (inquiry R11: BASIS_REFUSED, SELF_BASIS, BASIS_CYCLE; (T42) inquiry R62's and run-productions R25's PROPOSAL_NOT_TAKEN_UP, MACHINE_PASSAGE_UNCHECKED) is answered unchanged, with the handle and drift
R1: the refusals come in the stated order

R3: the answer carries cited, alreadyCited, drift, moved, bundleSha, rowVersion, the gate and its expiry, and question (null when none was named); pinned_captures only on a project; the per-leg fields only on an inquiry
R2: every other live file of the citing object is carried forward untouched
R7: weight is not a parameter — cite is report whatever the caller sends: a moved selection still cites

this module
tests: R2, R4: every case and question cite, sever and reinstate rewrote passes the catalogue's audit, before, between and after the withdrawal
R2, R4: the audit that finds the acts' documents clean is not blind — a citing document the catalogue refuses is counted
R15, R14: a question whose leg was severed and reinstated, and a case a question was drawn into, pass the catalogue's audit at every step
R20, R1, R19: cite with its fields in the POST body cites, and the stamps are still the address's
R20: a call with the fields only in the address still cites (a caller not yet moved), and the body wins where both are sent
R20, R1: a GET naming no source is refused CITE_ONE_SOURCE and writes nothing; control: the same call with a handle cites
R20, R1, R19: the part and the role travel in the body (flat `extent_*` and `content_id`), and a found match as an object or as one JSON string
R7, R20: no weight is read from the body either, and the declaration still accepts the same fields
R1: the selection is asked first, at weight report (retrieval R19): an unknown handle is refused before any citing object is looked up
R1, R9: an absent citing object and a project the viewer may not see answer the same NO_SUCH_PROJECT, membership's own answer (its R78) byte for byte; existence-only sight answers membership's C-70.1
R1: NOT_A_PROJECT for a citing object that is neither a project nor an inquiry, naming what it is; a legacy question spelling is the inquiry arm
R1: a project needs the actor joined (membership.projectAuthority): an administrator who sees it is refused, a joined owner is not; the question arm asks no position
R1, R11: BAD_NOTE (C-33.15) over 200 characters or with a quote, backslash or newline, carrying its row; a 200-character plain note passes
R1, R11: on an inquiry NO_ROLE (C-33.16) and BAD_ROLE (C-33.17) carry the role vocabulary; on a project ROLE_NOT_APPLICABLE (C-33.18)
R1: without inquiry's services the question arm is refused INQUIRY_UNAVAILABLE and writes nothing; the case arm is unaffected
R1: NOT_CITABLE (inquiry) and NOT_INFORMATION (project) name every member neither information nor an inquiry, sorted, with `citable`, and never narrow the call
R1, R5, R11: RETIRED_NOT_CITABLE (C-33.39) names every retired member, on both arms, and is asked of a retired bias set too
R1: an unreadable citing document is NO_BUNDLE_MD or UNPARSEABLE_FRONTMATTER
R1, R11: SEVERED_EDGE (C-33.19) for a member the citing object holds a severed edge to, naming only those, the whole call refused

R1, R11: the part — UNKNOWN_EXTENT_FIELD (C-45.7) listing the fields taken, EXTENT_NOT_APPLICABLE (C-45.8) on a project, EXTENT_ON_MANY (C-45.9) for more than one new member, BAD_EXTENT_VALUE (C-45.10)
R1: a part the leg grammar refuses (inquiry.checkLegExtentGrammar) is BASIS_REFUSED with each finding, before anything is written
R1: EMPTY_SELECTION when every member left the selection (purged), after the part is judged
R1: UNSPLICEABLE_REFERENCES when the references block cannot be extended in place, UNSPLICEABLE_BASIS for the basis block
R1: past 1 MiB, CITATION_TOO_LARGE with how many would fit, nothing written

R1: a refusal from the write (inquiry R11: BASIS_REFUSED, SELF_BASIS, BASIS_CYCLE; (T42) inquiry R62's and run-productions R25's PROPOSAL_NOT_TAKEN_UP, MACHINE_PASSAGE_UNCHECKED) is answered unchanged, with the handle and drift
R1: the refusals come in the stated order
R21: a second passage cited beside a grouped one is clean and carries no repairs (inquiry-grammar R68): the new leg is a necessary leg of its own

R21: the grouping finding the real grammar still raises through a cite, a cutting passage named into a group, is BASIS_REFUSED with its findings, repairs [] (the member named the group), nothing written; the same cite without the group lands
R21: a refusal with no repair states repairs: [], and an ungrouped basis is not refused
R21: a ground the question does not declare, and a ground on a case, are refused BAD_GROUND, writing nothing
R2: on a project each new member becomes a confirmed cites edge carrying the note, a document's pinned to content.captureFor's capture, a question's and an uncaptured document's not

R2, R8: on an inquiry each new member becomes a leg with the member's role, graded from inquiry.earned only where earned (connection, resolution), else carrying no grade, axis or source; a document leg pinned; its target joins references once
R8: an earned D, a letterless answer or no registry entry leaves the leg ungraded; the subject is read from the document's bytes
R2: a document leg that names a content id is not pinned again; a named part is written on the leg in the grammar's fixed order and answered as written
R2: over-strictness — a cite naming no part (or only empty part fields) writes exactly the leg a part-less act writes, with no extent line
R2: a member already cited is reported, not rewritten; with nothing new the answer is ok, cited empty, nothing written; a named part is said to have been written nowhere

R3: the write moves last_updated and appends one Session Log entry naming the author, the selection, at most 20 ids and a count of the rest, and the note; it counts records, a question among them, never calling them all information
R3: on an inquiry the entry states the role and how many legs were graded and left undetermined, inside the document's existing Session Log
R3: the entry says the set had moved when the selection's answer changed since it was made (report weight proceeds)

R3: the answer carries cited, alreadyCited, drift, moved, bundleSha, rowVersion, the gate and its expiry, and question (null when none was named); pinned_captures only on a project; the per-leg fields only on an inquiry

R1: EMPTY_SELECTION when every member left the selection (purged), after the part is judged

R1: the refusals come in the stated order

R16: refusals in order, each writing nothing: a machine or unnamed author, the citing object (absent, unseen, not a question), the ref, the edition, the role, the note

R16: a document whose basis block cannot be extended in place is refused UNSPLICEABLE_BASIS, one that does not parse by its readability refusal, and one that would pass 1 MiB CITATION_TOO_LARGE; nothing is written
R17: cite then withdraw leaves basisFor without the leg and the Session Log naming author, ref, edition and reason; the earlier bytes stay in history
R17: withdrawing one leg leaves the question's other legs untouched, byte for byte
R17: refusals in order, each writing nothing: a machine, the citing object, NO_REASON, BAD_REASON, NOT_CITED; a leg on an ordinary target is NOT_CITED here and sever still moves it

outside.waitsOn: retrieval: the item in its interface files
tests: R13: a found match cited onto a question, then the same findIn names its member under `recorded`, relation same, by and at as the question's history holds them; registration ends 'none registered'
R13: the read answers events R49's shape — a leg's part, `narrower` and `wider` against an asked extent, `document` for a leg naming none, and `disjoint` parts left out
R13: a project's cites edge is answered with extent document, and withdrawn after sever; its by and at stay the act that first wrote it
R13: `by` is whoever first wrote the leg into the citing object, by cite or by another act on its bytes; a later act on the same object changes no earlier leg's by
R13: a leg no longer in a basis is not an item

R13: the pin — an earlier capture's leg is absent from a later capture's read; an extent_capture names its capture; a content_id leg is its row's capture; an unpinned edge is the document's first-held capture
R13: sight is the citing object's — a citation inside a project the viewer may not see is neither answered nor counted, its truncated unchanged; a capture not held or not visible answers items: []
R13: refusals in events R49's form, writing nothing and adding no catalogue row — VIEWER_MISSING (absent or empty only), NO_SHA, EXTENT_MALFORMED
R13: limit is clamped to 1–500 (100 by default), truncated by reading one past; the read writes nothing

R13: registered once at start, through retrieval R76 — a second registration is refused LISTENER_DECLARED; a Citation made directly registers nothing (and without inquiry's projection refuses); never throws
R13: the same answer whether the projects are read in one statement over record-core's bundles contract or bundle by bundle
R13: an unpinned citation is answered for the capture its document's citation addresses at the read, so a document captured after it was cited is read for its new capture

tests: R15: sever on a question moves the references entry of each selected leg's target to severed, keeps the leg in basis[] byte for byte, and restsOnLive reads it severed; reinstate reads it confirmed
R15, R4: the answer is R4's, naming citingObjectType inquiry; the Session Log entry records the act, count, ids and reason; last_updated moves
R15: the entry moved is the one naming the leg's target whatever its relation, and a proposed one may be severed
R15: a member that is not the target of a leg of the question's basis is NOT_CITED to sever, a leg not severed NOT_SEVERED to reinstate, each the whole call, naming the offenders
R15: no actor-joined test on a question — a member in no project severs and reinstates its leg — while the case arm still asks it (control)
R15, R9: a question the viewer may not see answers exactly as an absent one, NO_SUCH_PROJECT's answer, and moves nothing

R15, R4: on a question every other refusal is R4's — NO_REASON, BAD_REASON, EMPTY_SELECTION, NOT_INFORMATION, RETIRED_NOT_CITABLE for a reinstate, NO_BUNDLE_MD, UNPARSEABLE_FRONTMATTER, UNSPLICEABLE_REFERENCES
R15, R7: on a question sever and reinstate are refuse weight: a moved selection is SET_MOVED and nothing moves

R15, R64: a sever on a divided question is refused by inquiry's own R64 answer, DIVIDED_CANNOT_RESTRUCTURE naming the question and its children, relayed unchanged with the handle and drift; nothing is written
R15, R1: a leg severed on a question is not re-cited by cite (SEVERED_EDGE), and is restored only by reinstate
